title: 状语从句：原因、结果、让步
en: Clauses of Reason, Result and Contrast

markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 这些小句子回答四个问题：**为什么**（because）、**结果怎样**（so … that）、**虽然……还是**（although）、**为了什么**（so that）。

uses.en_zh: 我累了，因为加班到很晚。

uses.en: The meeting was [[so]] long [[that]] I missed lunch.
uses.en_zh: 会开得太久，我都没吃上午饭。

uses.en: [[Although]] it was raining, we went out.
uses.en_zh: 虽然在下雨，我们还是出门了。

uses.en: I left early [[so that]] I could catch the train.

reason.title: 原因：because / since / as
reason.rule: **because** 最常用，回答「为什么」。**since** 和 **as** 常放句首，说大家都知道的原因。**because of** 后面只跟名词，不跟句子。

examples.en: I'm late [[because]] my train was cancelled.
examples.zh: 我迟到了，因为火车取消了。

examples.en: [[Since]] you're here, can you look at this bug?
examples.zh: 既然你在，能帮我看看这个 bug 吗？

examples.en: We stayed in [[because of]] the rain.
examples.zh: 因为下雨，我们待在家里。

wrong.good: We stayed in [[because of]] the rain.

result.title: 结果：so / so … that / such … that
result.rule: 「**so + 形容词 + that**」和「**such + a + 名词 + that**」都是「太……所以……」。so 单独用就是「所以」。

examples.en: The app was [[so]] slow [[that]] users gave up.
examples.zh: App 慢到用户都放弃了。

examples.en: It was [[such]] a good talk [[that]] nobody left early.
examples.zh: 演讲太精彩了，没一个人提前走。

examples.en: The server was down, [[so]] we went home.
examples.zh: 服务器挂了，所以我们回家了。

result.tip: 口诀：**so 跟形容词，such 跟名词。** so tired · such a long day。

concession.title: 让步：although / even though
concession.rule: **although** = 「虽然」。英语里 although 和 but **只能留一个**，不像中文「虽然……但是」。**even though** 语气更强：「就算真的……也」。

examples.en: [[Although]] the fix was small, it took all day.
examples.zh: 虽然改动很小，却花了一整天。

examples.en: She came to work [[even though]] she was ill.
examples.zh: 她虽然病了，还是来上班了。

examples.en: It's a nice flat. It's a bit small, [[though]].
examples.zh: 这公寓挺好的，就是有点小。

wrong.bad: Although it was late, ~~but~~ we kept working.
wrong.good: [[Although]] it was late, we kept working.

notes: though 放句末，意思是「不过」，口语里特别常见。

purpose.title: 目的：so that / to
purpose.rule: **so that** = 「为了、好让」，后面是一句完整的话，常带 can / could / will / would。前后是同一个人时，用「**to + 动词**」更简单。

examples.en: I'll write it down [[so that]] I don't forget.
examples.zh: 我把它写下来，免得忘了。

examples.en: Speak up [[so that]] everyone [[can]] hear you.
examples.zh: 大声点，好让大家都听得到。

examples.en: I came in early [[to]] ((finish)) the report.
examples.zh: 我早点来是为了写完报告。

this.en: I left early [[so that]] I could catch the train.

that.en: I left early, [[so]] I caught the train.

this.en: [[Although]] it was raining, we went out.

commonMistakes.bad: Although it was late, ~~but~~ we kept working.
commonMistakes.good: [[Although]] it was late, we kept working.
commonMistakes.why: although 和 but 只留一个。

commonMistakes.bad: Because it rained, ~~so~~ we stayed in.
commonMistakes.why: because 和 so 也只留一个。

commonMistakes.bad: ~~Despite of~~ the rain, we went out.

commonMistakes.good: We stayed in [[because of]] the rain.
commonMistakes.why: 后面只有名词，用 because of。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我累了，因为我加班到很晚。
quiz.answer: I'm tired because I worked late.
accept: I am tired because I worked late.
I'm tired because I worked late last night.

quiz.explain: 后面只有名词 the rain，用 [[because of]]。

quiz.prompt: ___ you're here, can you look at this bug?（既然）
It was ___ a good talk that nobody left early.
quiz.explain: 后面是名词 a good talk，用 [[such]]。

quiz.prompt: The app was ___ slow that users gave up.
用 so … that 合成一句：The meeting was very long. I missed lunch.
quiz.answer: The meeting was so long that I missed lunch.

quiz.prompt: 改错：Although it was late, but we kept working.
quiz.answer: Although it was late, we kept working.
accept: It was late, but we kept working.
quiz.explain: although 和 but 只留一个。

quiz.prompt: She came to work even ___ she was ill.
翻译：虽然改动很小，却花了一整天。
quiz.answer: Although the fix was small, it took all day.
accept: Although the change was small, it took all day.
Even though the fix was small, it took all day.
Though the fix was small, it took all day.
Although the change was small, it took the whole day.
Although the fix was small, it took the whole day.

quiz.prompt: I'll write it down so ___ I don't forget.
I came in early ___ finish the report.
quiz.explain: 前后同一个人，用 [[to]] + 动词原形。

quiz.prompt: 用 so that 合成一句：Speak up. Everyone can hear you.
quiz.answer: Speak up so that everyone can hear you.
accept: Speak up so everyone can hear you.
quiz.explain: [[so that]] 后面是完整的一句话。

quiz.prompt: I left early, ___ I caught the train.（结果赶上了）
改错：Because it rained, so we stayed in.
quiz.answer: Because it rained, we stayed in.
accept: It rained, so we stayed in.
quiz.explain: because 和 so 只留一个。

quiz.prompt: 改错：Despite of the rain, we went out.
quiz.answer: Despite the rain, we went out.
accept: In spite of the rain, we went out.

quiz.prompt: 用 despite 改写：Although it was raining, we went out.
quiz.answer: Despite the rain, we went out.
accept: Despite the rain we went out.
We went out despite the rain.
Despite the fact that it was raining, we went out.
Despite it raining, we went out.
quiz.explain: despite 后面跟名词 the rain。

openTask.prompt: 说说你最近遇到的一个麻烦（比如一个难修的 bug 或一次延误），用 3 句话讲清楚：为什么、结果怎样、虽然……还是……。
rules: although 和 but、because 和 so 不能同时用
so 跟形容词，such 跟名词
openTask.note: 规则判连接词搭配（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
